name: NEXORA
concept: An AI platform presented as a digital organism: agents, automation, perception and reasoning share one nervous system that grows as you explore.
signature: a Three.js neural universe that rewires itself into a new topology for each capability you select.

name: QUANTUMNEST
concept: A quantum-computing company that turns difficult science into an elegant museum-plate experience with clearly labelled illustrative visuals.
signature: a crystalline 3D sculpture that re-forms for each concept, with animated scientific diagrams.

name: VÉLORA
concept: An avant-garde fashion house whose website plays like a fashion film: four pinned scenes, sliced typography and a touchable silk surface.
signature: a WebGL silk shader you can disturb, driving a scroll-scrubbed four-scene film.

name: TERRA & THREAD
concept: A sustainable label focused on materials and craft, told through tactile editorial spreads and an honest material story.
signature: a material-to-garment journey: fibre becomes yarn, weave and finally a garment.

name: ZENITH
concept: A digital mindfulness sanctuary: an evening landscape where the sun rises and sets with your breath.
signature: user-paced breathing sessions with pace control, pause/reset and a follow-my-breath mode.

name: VITALIS
concept: A longevity education platform that explains the body through precise data graphics and a dark scientific dashboard.
signature: an interactive human-body diagram linked to filterable education panels and sample-data charts.

name: SOLSTICE
concept: A premium travel brand built on emotional storytelling, with destination chapters that move from dawn to dusk.
signature: cinematic destination chapters plus a working itinerary builder.

name: WAYFARER
concept: A cartographic discovery platform where browsing places feels like navigating a living atlas.
signature: an interactive world map with themed filters, animated routes and session-saved places.

name: EMBER
concept: A chef-led dining room where each course is told as a story, from ingredient to finished plate.
signature: a tasting journey connecting ingredient, preparation and dish, with a reservation inquiry.

name: THE ALCHEMIST
concept: An experimental beverage studio that turns flavour into living liquid compositions.
signature: a flavour explorer that generates a fluid visual composition and a drink name from your choices.

name: SKYLINE ACADEMY
concept: A futuristic learning environment where subjects and courses form an explorable universe.
signature: a navigable 3D knowledge universe with filterable courses and selectable learning paths.

name: MINDCRAFT
concept: A hands-on learning studio for makers and designers, designed like a workshop pegboard.
signature: a skill map that unlocks real project examples as you choose skills.

name: LUMEN RESIDENCES
concept: A residential brand that presents homes as architectural experiences of concrete, glass and light.
signature: room-by-room exploration from an interactive floor plan, with property filters.

name: VERDURA ARCHITECTS
concept: An architecture studio whose case studies connect sketches, materials, form and environmental decisions.
signature: an interactive case study with drawings that draw on and toggleable sun, wind and water layers.

name: LUMINA FILMS
concept: An independent film studio with a letterboxed, credit-roll editorial world.
signature: film discovery with cinematic reveals and an animated teaser player with play, pause and scrub.

name: PIXELVERSE
concept: A game-world studio whose website is a miniature floating world to explore.
signature: a navigable 3D world with clickable locations and lore panels.

name: ORION CAPITAL
concept: A private-bank style planning room that makes long-term financial thinking clear, with every figure labelled hypothetical.
signature: an illustrative planning simulator with purpose targets, scenario comparison and a star-chart timeline.

name: NIMBUS
concept: A cloud-infrastructure company that explains systems through living architecture diagrams.
signature: an interactive infrastructure map with a simulated configuration and live-updating sample metrics.

name: CANVAS
concept: A digital art platform designed as an evolving exhibition rather than an image grid.
signature: walkable gallery rooms of interactive, regenerating generative artworks.

name: HARMONIX
concept: An audio-visual studio whose website is a playable instrument: sound, geometry and colour in one surface.
signature: sixteen playable pads driving a Web Audio synth with reactive procedural visuals.
